options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name; grids are named "{label}, {period}".

options.name: events
options.description: Events: { id, title, start: Instant | PlainDate, end (exclusive instant or inclusive last day), timeZone?, recurrence?, seriesId?, originalStart?, resourceId?, color?, location?, description?, readOnly? }.

options.name: loadEvents
options.description: Range data source instead of events (single events overlapping the range, series masters that may occur in it, and their exceptions).

options.name: resources
options.description: Timeline rows: { id, label, description?, color? }.

options.name: view
options.description: Current view.

options.name: views
options.description: Views in the switcher. Default: day, week, work week, month, agenda (plus timeline with resources).

options.name: date
options.description: A day in the visible period. Default: today in the timezone.

options.name: editable
options.description: Move and resize events (pointer, keyboard, toolbar).

options.name: recurringEditScope
options.description: How changes to recurring occurrences apply; ask shows a dialog.

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Working days (work week), working hours (shading), holidays (headers).

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: First day of weeks. Default: the locale's first day of week.

options.name: createId
options.description: Id of events created from base (exceptions, split series). Default "{id}~{hint}".

options.name: renderEvent
options.description: Event content (non-interactive).

options.name: now
options.description: Advanced: fixed current time (tests, demos); disables the per-minute refresh.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: slotDuration
options.description: Minutes per slot (time view rows, day timeline columns).

options.name: snapDuration
options.description: Minutes moves and resizes snap to.

options.name: dayStartHour
options.description: First hour shown in time views (0-23).

options.name: dayEndHour
options.description: Last hour shown, exclusive (1-24, after dayStartHour).

options.name: scrollToHour
options.description: Hour scrolled into view (and focused) when a time view opens.

options.name: monthEventLimit
options.description: Rows of events per month cell before "+N more".

options.name: agendaDays
options.description: Days listed by the agenda (1-62).

options.name: timelineScale
options.description: Timeline columns: slots of a day, days of a week, or days of a month.

options.name: requestTimeoutMs
options.description: loadEvents timeout.

options.name: historyLimit
options.description: Undo depth (0 disables undo).

options.name: locale
options.description: Month and weekday names, dates, numbers, the first day of the week, and messages.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Timezone of the layout, today, slots, and new times.

options.name: disambiguation
options.description: DST policy for wall-clock times in a gap or overlap (SPEC section 8.5).

options.name: direction
options.description: Reading direction; Left/Right arrow keys and chevrons follow it.

properties.name: date
properties.description: Anchor date of the visible period.

properties.name: range
properties.description: { start, end (instants), startDate, endDate (inclusive) } of the visible days.

properties.name: occurrences
properties.description: Occurrences in the visible range, sorted (key, event, start, end, allDay, recurring, seriesId, originalStart).

properties.name: businessCalendar
properties.description: Engine of the business calendar definition.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The current grid (or the agenda region).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; events replace the list and clear history.

methods.name: goTo / next / previous / today
methods.signature: goTo(date: PlainDate): void; next(): void; previous(): void; today(): void
methods.description: Change the period (next and previous emit aui-navigate).

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Discard cached ranges and reload the visible range.

methods.name: moveEvent
methods.signature: moveEvent(key: string, start: Instant | PlainDate, options?: { resourceId?: string; scope?: SchedulerEditScope }): boolean
methods.description: Programmatic move of a visible occurrence (emits the cancelable aui-event-change; false when refused).

methods.name: resizeEvent
methods.signature: resizeEvent(key: string, end: Instant | PlainDate, options?: { scope?: SchedulerEditScope }): boolean

methods.name: undo / redo
methods.description: Step through edits (emit aui-event-change with reason undo/redo).

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the current cell or event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Abort requests and remove rendering, listeners, timers, and subscriptions.

methods.name: expandEvents / applyEdit / packColumns / packLanes
methods.signature: expandEvents(events, range): SchedulerOccurrence[]; applyEdit(events, request): { events; changes } | null; packColumns(spans); packLanes(spans)
methods.description: Module functions: the pure model and layout (server-side expansion, tests).

events.name: aui-navigate
events.detail: { view: SchedulerView; date: PlainDate; range: SchedulerRange }
events.description: The user changed the view or period.

events.name: aui-slot-activate
events.detail: { start: Instant | PlainDate; end: Instant | PlainDate; allDay: boolean; resourceId: string | null }
events.description: The user asked to create an event (Enter on an empty cell, Shift+Enter, a selection, a pointer range, or a double-click).

events.name: aui-event-activate
events.description: The user activated an event (click, Enter, Space).

events.name: aui-event-change
events.detail: { reason: "move" | "resize" | "undo" | "redo"; occurrence: SchedulerOccurrence | null; scope: SchedulerEditScope | null; changes: { added; updated; removed }; events: SchedulerEvent[] }
events.description: Before a change is applied; preventDefault() refuses it.

events.name: aui-event-delete
events.description: Delete or Backspace on an editable event (the application removes it).

events.name: aui-load-error
events.description: loadEvents failed, timed out, or returned invalid events.

cssClasses.name: aui-scheduler | --day | --week | --workWeek | --month | --agenda | --timeline | --editable
cssClasses.description: Host and view modifiers; custom properties --aui-scheduler-slot, --aui-scheduler-lane, --aui-scheduler-date, --aui-scheduler-height size the grid.
